notes:
What's new in 0.1.60:
• Household size limit raised to 15 people total (owner plus paid extra seats), up from 12, matching what other services offer.
• Added six ready-made layout styles you can pick in one click in Appearance settings, instead of only building your own.
• Turning on private viewing history now checks you have a real, working recovery email first (and sends a confirmation to prove it), so you can never lock yourself out with no way back in.
• Behind-the-scenes account and connection-security fixes from an independent security review.
